request: Make a one-minute introduction to Egatari for people who have never heard of it, in 6 slides: figures build in the order you speak, slides and a book in one file, the quality check fixes what the AI wrote, and it opens in any browser. One point per slide. Mark example numbers as fictional, and add a short book.

structure.heading: Visuals narrate. You pass it on.
structure.point: Cover: the name and a one-line description

structure.heading: Figures build in the order you speak
structure.point: A report as the example: number cards, then bars, step by step (fictional numbers)

structure.heading: Slides and a book, in one file
structure.point: Two cards: the side you show and the side you read

structure.heading: The AI need not get it right the first time
structure.point: A quality-check finding, fixed in one round

structure.heading: Anywhere there is a browser
structure.point: One file that opens in a browser; ways to use it

structure.heading: This introduction was made with Egatari
structure.point: This introduction was made with Egatari; where to start
